steps.title: Establish Project Configuration
steps.description: Configure build.gradle with strict target SDK 34, AGP 8.3.2, and compile-time specifications matching the GitHub Actions environment.

steps.title: Define Application Manifest
steps.description: Establish the AndroidManifest.xml structure utilizing valid namespaces, target activities, hardware sensors, and application details.

steps.title: Create Die Board Asset Drawables
steps.description: Design custom rounded XML shapes and shadow definitions for die containers to give a realistic board game physical rendering.

steps.title: Create Die Face Dot Drawables
steps.description: Define circle shape XML templates for the dots rendered inside die configurations.

steps.title: Configure Button and Card UI Components
steps.description: Generate custom button background selectors, press behaviors, and card background frames using raw XML assets.

steps.title: Configure Tab Selectors
steps.description: Provide custom interactive states for tab navigation to denote active and inactive states cleanly.

steps.title: Create Real-time PCM Sound Synthesizer
steps.description: Implement raw AudioTrack processing class in Java to synthesize physical dice clattering sounds and triumphant victory chimes on-the-fly without requiring external audio assets.

steps.title: Develop XML User Interface Layout
steps.description: Assemble responsive UI panels for Solo Roller, two-player Battle Mode, Jeopardy Pig Game, and persistent statistics board.

steps.title: Bind UI Elements & Multi-Tab Routing
steps.description: Initialize view binding in MainActivity.java to link classic rolling, battle arenas, and settings tabs dynamically.

steps.title: Implement Randomizer & Physics Rolling Simulator
steps.description: Implement visual roll cycles using Handlers to animate random states before matching final output for high physical fidelity.

steps.title: Develop Accelerometer Shake-to-Roll Handler
steps.description: Integrate standard Android SensorEventListener logic with real-time vector calculations and custom debounce filters.

steps.title: Program Solo Mode and Battle Engine
steps.description: Write complex gaming state logic supporting multiple counts, scoreboard aggregation, high scores, and persistent roll frequencies.

steps.title: Program Jeopardy Pig Game Engine
steps.description: Integrate strategic jeopardy game loops with roll, hold, and turn points penalty configurations for Player 1 and Player 2.

steps.title: Implement Style & Theme Customization Layer
steps.description: Develop runtime primary color switching triggers (Casino Green, Indigo Night, Onyx Black) utilizing global view references.

steps.title: Building Dice Master Pro
steps.description: Synthesize resources and execute project compilation verifying absolute stability and error-free builds.
